findings.title: splitEvenly silently loses remainder cents
evidence: node --input-type=module -e 'import { splitEvenly } from "./src/money.js"; const result = splitEvenly(10, 3); console.log(JSON.stringify({ result, total: result.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0), expectedTotal: 10 }));'

findings.title: applyDiscount always applies a full discount
evidence: node --input-type=module -e 'import { applyDiscount } from "./src/money.js"; const actual = applyDiscount(1000, 10); console.log(JSON.stringify({ actual, expected: 900 }));'
